theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtsr_segment_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x y : Euclid P) (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (x + t • (y - x)), dist (f w) (f (x + t • (y - x))) ≤ K * dist w (x + t • (y - x))) → dist (f y) (f x) ≤ K * dist y x
